name: Alex de Minaur
signature: slight, wiry build and very fast; dark hair, often a cap
exaggerate: fastest feet in the game (motion blur on runs)
source: personality: public media, one link per claim in `sources` (Nov 5 2026); signature/build: general public knowledge, still to check against images; outfits wait on uploads (#18) Body numbers added Nov 11 2026 from the 2026 ATP media guide where the player is listed, otherwise the source named in body.

grass.notes: all-white dress code; trim colours to research

hard.notes: He often wears a cap (signature). Cap colour at the US Open was not sourced; the dark cap is a neutral default on the navy shirt.

clay.notes: Neutral default kit. A citable clay colour was not found for this run.

personality.temperament: fierce competitor, never gives up a ball
personality.style: counterpuncher with elite speed and flat, low strokes
celebrations: loud 'come on!' with a fist pump
draws/signs the little 'Demon' devil on the camera lens
personality.notes: public media; 'Demon' from a junior coach's play on his surname and his speed; calls himself a fighter and 'quite a normal kid'

sources.claim: 'Demon' nickname from junior coach Ben Pyne (surname + speed)
'I don't want any regrets': fighter mindset

conflicts: Tennis Companion's ATP-derived table lists 69 kg. The 2026 media guide lists 68 kg. The game uses 68 kg.

reachM.note: Same formula as bodyStats() in index.html. Not a measured wingspan. datasets/players/<id>/body.json does not exist yet (Body Scout has not run).

letRate.note: Same range already used for Sinner (0.02) and Alcaraz (0.03): lets on roughly 1–3% of pro serves. Not counted from a match log.

skills.scale: 1–20, 10 = neutral, the Skills Coach scale in src/skills/skills.js
skills.note: Not a measured rating. Set from the published style already in this file (serve size, footspeed, touch) so the locker room is not all 10s.

torsoScale.note: look.torso in src/players/roster.js is a pixel width multiplier taken from words already in signature/exaggerate (lanky, broad, slim). It is not a measured shoulder width.

favouriteServes.summary: Not a serve-led game; footspeed is the trait the skills follow.
